tasks.title: Setup Electron Project Structure
tasks.description: Initialize the Electron project with React, TypeScript, and electron-store, setting up the main process and renderer processes architecture.
tasks.details:
1. Create new project using Electron Forge with TypeScript template
2. Add React 18+ and TypeScript 5+ dependencies
3. Configure webpack for React support
4. Set up folder structure (main, renderer, common)
5. Configure electron-store for persistence
6. Implement basic IPC communication between processes
7. Create initial system tray integration
8. Set up development environment with hot reload
tasks.testStrategy: Verify project builds and runs without errors. Test IPC communication between main and renderer processes. Ensure system tray appears correctly.

subtasks.title: Initialize Electron project with TypeScript and setup folder structure
subtasks.description: Create a new Electron project using Electron Forge with TypeScript template and establish the basic folder structure for the application architecture.
subtasks.details:
1. Install Electron Forge CLI globally: `npm install -g @electron-forge/cli`
2. Create new project: `electron-forge init my-app --template=typescript`
3. Navigate to project directory: `cd my-app`
4. Set up folder structure:
   - `/src/main` - Main process code
   - `/src/renderer` - Renderer process code
   - `/src/common` - Shared code between processes
5. Move existing TypeScript configuration and main process code to appropriate folders
6. Update tsconfig.json to include path aliases for the new folder structure
7. Update package.json scripts to reflect the new structure
8. Test by running `npm start` to verify the basic Electron app launches
9. Commit the initial project structure

subtasks.title: Integrate React with TypeScript and configure webpack
subtasks.description: Add React to the project, configure webpack for React support, and implement hot reload for development.
subtasks.details:
1. Install React dependencies: `npm install react react-dom @types/react @types/react-dom`
2. Install webpack and related dependencies: `npm install --save-dev webpack webpack-cli webpack-dev-server html-webpack-plugin ts-loader css-loader style-loader file-loader`
3. Create webpack.config.js in project root with configuration for React and TypeScript
4. Create a basic React component in `/src/renderer/App.tsx`
5. Create an HTML template in `/src/renderer/index.html`
6. Update main process code to load the webpack-built renderer
7. Configure hot reload by:
   - Installing `electron-reloader` as dev dependency
   - Adding hot reload configuration to main process
8. Update package.json scripts to include webpack build and dev server
9. Test the setup by running dev script and verifying React components render
10. Verify hot reload is working by making changes to React components

subtasks.title: Implement electron-store and IPC communication with system tray integration
subtasks.description: Set up data persistence with electron-store, establish IPC communication between main and renderer processes, and create the system tray integration.
subtasks.details:
1. Install electron-store: `npm install electron-store`
2. Create a store configuration in `/src/main/store.ts`:
   - Define types for stored data
   - Initialize electron-store with appropriate options
   - Export store instance
3. Implement IPC communication:
   - Define IPC channel constants in `/src/common/ipc.ts`
   - Create main process handlers in `/src/main/ipc.ts` to handle renderer requests
   - Implement renderer process IPC client in `/src/renderer/utils/ipc.ts`
4. Add system tray integration:
   - Create tray icon assets in `/assets` folder
   - Implement tray module in `/src/main/tray.ts`
   - Add context menu to tray with basic actions
   - Connect tray actions to main process functions
5. Test persistence by saving and retrieving data
6. Test IPC by sending messages between processes
7. Test system tray by verifying icon appears and context menu works
8. Add error handling for all implemented features

tasks.title: Implement Configuration System
tasks.description: Create the data models and storage system for widget configurations and application settings.
tasks.details:
1. Implement the WidgetConfig and AppSettings interfaces as defined in the PRD
2. Set up electron-store for persistent storage
3. Create helper functions for CRUD operations on widget configurations
4. Implement default settings and configuration migration handling
5. Add validation for configuration data
6. Create configuration export/import functionality
7. Implement event emitters for configuration changes
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test CRUD operations for configurations. Verify persistence across application restarts. Test configuration validation with valid and invalid inputs.

subtasks.title: Implement Core Data Models and Storage Setup
subtasks.description: Create the WidgetConfig and AppSettings interfaces and set up electron-store for persistent storage with basic CRUD operations.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Define the WidgetConfig interface according to the PRD, including properties for widget ID, type, position, size, and custom settings
2. Define the AppSettings interface according to the PRD, including properties for theme, language, update preferences, etc.
3. Install and configure electron-store package
4. Create a ConfigStore class that initializes electron-store with appropriate schema and defaults
5. Implement basic CRUD helper functions (get, set, delete) for both widget configurations and application settings
6. Add type safety throughout the implementation
7. Write unit tests for the data models and CRUD operations

Testing approach:
- Write unit tests for the data models to ensure they conform to the PRD specifications
- Test CRUD operations with mock data
- Verify persistence by writing and reading from the store

subtasks.title: Implement Configuration Validation and Defaults
subtasks.description: Add validation for configuration data and implement default settings with configuration migration handling.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Create validation schemas for WidgetConfig and AppSettings using a validation library (e.g., Zod, Joi)
2. Implement validation functions that can be called before saving configurations
3. Create a default configuration factory for generating proper defaults for new widgets and application settings
4. Implement a version field in the configuration to track schema versions
5. Create a migration system that can upgrade old configuration formats to newer ones
6. Add error handling for validation failures with appropriate user feedback
7. Create recovery mechanisms for corrupted configurations

Testing approach:
- Test validation with valid and invalid configurations
- Verify default settings are correctly applied for new installations
- Test migration paths from older to newer configuration versions
- Test error handling and recovery from corrupted configurations

subtasks.title: Implement Configuration Events and Import/Export
subtasks.description: Create configuration change events and implement export/import functionality for configurations.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Create an event emitter system for configuration changes using Node's EventEmitter or a similar pattern
2. Implement specific events for widget configuration changes, additions, and deletions
3. Add events for application settings changes
4. Create an export function that can serialize configurations to JSON files
5. Implement an import function that can read configurations from JSON files
6. Add validation to the import process to ensure only valid configurations are imported
7. Create a backup system that automatically backs up configurations before major changes
8. Implement a simple API for other parts of the application to subscribe to configuration changes

Testing approach:
- Test event emission on various configuration changes
- Verify event subscribers receive appropriate notifications
- Test the export functionality produces valid JSON files
- Test import functionality with both valid and invalid configuration files
- Verify the entire import/export cycle preserves all configuration data

tasks.title: Create Basic Widget Window

tasks.details:

3. Add WebView component for content display

5. Implement basic error handling for content loading
6. Add resize functionality with proper constraints
7. Create window position tracking
8. Implement basic content refresh functionality
tasks.testStrategy: Test window creation with various URLs. Verify resize functionality works correctly. Confirm content loads properly and is sandboxed. Test error handling with invalid URLs.

subtasks.title: Implement Frameless BrowserWindow with Web Content Display
subtasks.description: Create the core frameless window using Electron's BrowserWindow API and configure WebView for displaying web content with proper security settings.
subtasks.details:
1. Initialize a new BrowserWindow with frameless configuration (frame: false)
2. Configure proper content isolation settings in webPreferences (contextIsolation: true, sandbox: true)
3. Set up a preload script for secure communication between renderer and main processes
4. Implement the WebView component for content display
5. Configure content security policy (CSP) headers
6. Add basic error handling for content loading failures
7. Test the window creation and content loading with various URLs
8. Verify security settings using Electron's security checklist

subtasks.title: Implement Custom Window Chrome and Controls
subtasks.description: Create a custom window frame with minimize, maximize, and close buttons to replace the native window controls removed in the frameless configuration.
subtasks.details:
1. Design a custom title bar component that matches application styling
2. Implement minimize, maximize/restore, and close buttons with appropriate icons
3. Connect button actions to the corresponding BrowserWindow methods (minimize(), maximize(), close())
4. Add window dragging functionality by handling mousedown/mousemove events on the title bar
5. Implement double-click to maximize/restore on the title bar
6. Add visual feedback for button hover and active states
7. Test window controls across different operating systems
8. Ensure keyboard shortcuts (Alt+F4, etc.) still work properly

subtasks.title: Implement Window Resizing and Position Management
subtasks.description: Add resize functionality with proper constraints and implement window position tracking to maintain state between sessions.
subtasks.details:
1. Create resize handles on window edges and corners using CSS and JavaScript
2. Implement resize logic by tracking mousedown/mousemove events on resize handles
3. Add minimum and maximum size constraints to prevent unusable window sizes
4. Implement window position tracking by saving coordinates on window move and close events
5. Store window position and size in application settings using electron-store or similar
6. Restore previous window position and size on application restart
7. Add logic to ensure window is always visible on screen (handle multi-monitor setups)
8. Test resizing behavior with different content types and window states
9. Implement graceful fallback if saved position is invalid (e.g., monitor no longer available)

tasks.title: Implement Drag-and-Drop Positioning
tasks.description: Add the ability to drag widgets around the desktop and persist their positions.
tasks.details:
1. Create custom drag regions on widget windows
2. Implement mouse event handlers for drag operations
3. Add position boundary checking for multi-monitor support
4. Create position persistence logic to save locations
5. Implement drag start/in-progress/end visual feedback
6. Add position reset functionality
7. Ensure smooth dragging performance
8. Handle edge cases like screen resolution changes
tasks.testStrategy: Test dragging widgets across the screen and between monitors. Verify position persistence after application restart. Test boundary conditions and edge cases.

subtasks.title: Implement Widget Drag Detection and Movement
subtasks.description: Create the core drag functionality that allows users to click and drag widgets across the desktop. This includes setting up custom drag regions, implementing mouse event handlers, and ensuring smooth movement.
subtasks.details:
1. Define custom drag regions on widget headers/title bars using mouse event listeners (mousedown, mousemove, mouseup).
2. Implement a dragging state manager that tracks when dragging begins, continues, and ends.
3. Calculate position delta between mouse movements to update widget positions.
4. Add visual feedback during dragging (e.g., cursor change, slight opacity change, or shadow effect).
5. Implement throttling or requestAnimationFrame for smooth performance during drag operations.
6. Add event propagation control to prevent unintended interactions with widget content during dragging.

Testing approach:
- Unit test the drag state transitions and position calculations
- Manual testing with different mouse movement speeds
- Performance testing to ensure smooth dragging even with multiple widgets

subtasks.title: Add Position Constraints and Multi-Monitor Support
subtasks.description: Implement boundary checking to ensure widgets remain accessible within the visible desktop area, including support for multi-monitor setups and handling edge cases.
subtasks.details:
1. Detect available screen dimensions using screen API or equivalent for your framework (e.g., `window.screen` properties in web apps, `QGuiApplication::screens()` in Qt).
2. Implement boundary checking to prevent widgets from being dragged completely off-screen.
3. Add multi-monitor detection to identify when widgets cross between displays.
4. Handle different DPI settings between monitors by adjusting position calculations.
5. Implement position normalization for screen resolution changes.
6. Add a position reset functionality that returns widgets to default or last valid position.
7. Create helper functions to convert between absolute and relative positioning for different screens.

Testing approach:
- Test with simulated multi-monitor configurations
- Test boundary cases (dragging to screen edges, corners)
- Test screen resolution and DPI changes
- Test with different monitor arrangements (side-by-side, stacked)

subtasks.title: Implement Position Persistence and State Management
subtasks.description: Create a system to save and restore widget positions between application sessions, ensuring widget placement preferences are maintained.
subtasks.details:
1. Design a data structure to store widget positions (e.g., JSON with widget IDs and x/y coordinates).
2. Implement position serialization and deserialization functions.
3. Add event listeners to save positions when widgets are moved (consider debouncing to avoid excessive writes).
4. Create a position storage service that interfaces with local storage (localStorage, IndexedDB, file system, etc. depending on platform).
5. Implement position restoration logic during application startup.
6. Add error handling for cases where saved positions are invalid (e.g., if screen configuration has changed).
7. Implement a migration strategy for handling changes to the position data structure in future updates.

Testing approach:
- Unit test serialization/deserialization functions
- Test persistence across application restarts
- Test recovery from invalid saved positions
- Test with different widget configurations and counts

subtasks.description: Configure code signing for all platforms and implement auto-update functionality to ensure users can receive application updates.
subtasks.details:
1. Obtain code signing certificates for each platform (Windows, macOS, and Linux)
2. Configure code signing in Electron Forge for each platform
3. Set up an update server or use a service like GitHub releases
4. Implement the auto-update module using Electron's autoUpdater
5. Add update checking logic on application startup
6. Create update notification UI for users
7. Implement update download and installation process
8. Add update-related user preferences (automatic vs. manual)
9. Test the update process on all platforms
10. Document the update workflow for both developers and end-users

subtasks.title: Add User Onboarding, Analytics and License Management
subtasks.description: Implement first-run experience, crash reporting, analytics, and license management to improve user experience and application monitoring.
subtasks.details:
1. Implement a first-run detection mechanism
2. Create an onboarding workflow with key feature introduction
3. Design and implement onboarding UI screens
4. Integrate a crash reporting service (like Sentry or Bugsnag)
5. Add analytics to track feature usage and application performance
6. Implement license key validation and storage
7. Create license activation and deactivation workflows
8. Add license status checks on application startup
9. Design license-related UI (activation, status display)
10. Create comprehensive installation documentation for end-users
11. Test the entire workflow from installation to license activation
12. Ensure analytics respects user privacy settings and applicable regulations
